name: La Giettaz
description: La Giettaz is a small pearl in the Aravis mountains. Authentic, friendly, familiar. The Portes du Mont-Blanc ski area links it to Megève-Jaillet and Combloux (100km, 28 red runs, 8 black). Known as one of the best freeride spots in the Alps — but kept quiet by those in the know. The 360° panorama from Tête du Torraz summit is breathtaking. Quieter and more affordable than nearby Megève.

overview.atmosphere: Authentic Savoyard village in the Aravis mountains. Part of Portes du Mont-Blanc ski area. One of the best freeride spots in the Alps — kept quiet. 360° panorama of Mont Blanc from Tête du Torraz (1,930m). Peaceful, traditional, unspoilt.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Hiking, mountain biking, giant swing at Jaillet (Megève side), playground at gondola top
